scope: All 26 cantons: source discovery, public acquisition probes and documented unresolved work. Not a full route-to-geometry validation.
limits: Representative agency IDs are review starting points, not exhaustive canton memberships. Include national/cross-border operators by routes and stops. Tariff products overlap and do not define government authority or data coverage. A not-found result is limited to the documented sources checked.

cantons.name: Zürich
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: ZVV; Stadt Zürich / VBZ data publisher
cantons.evidence: Integrated ZVV GTFS with shapes is the existing implementation baseline. The city catalogue API still resolves the 2026 download and declares cc-zero. This is a regional feed, not an independent feed for every operator.
cantons.vintage: 2026 archive advertised; existing measured integration retains its own pinned source date.
cantons.reuse: City catalogue declares CC0 for the feed; retain provenance and distinguish other cantonal layers.
cantons.nextAction: Refresh the pinned ZVV feed and assess all route patterns and cross-canton termini before expanding the existing footprint.

cantons.name: Bern
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Bern public transport planning; cantonal Geoportal / Amt für Geoinformation
cantons.evidence: OEVTP GeoPackage downloaded and SQLite tables inspected: 518 line records, 5,321 stop records and 139 Libero polygons, plus catchment/accessibility layers. Line fields include liniencode, liniennr, tucode, tuname and kubunr. GeoParquet also downloaded, but only its signature was checked.
cantons.vintage: Line layer updated 1 January 2026; packaged metadata published 9 July 2026.
cantons.reuse: Packaged terms dated 20 January 2026 allow free private/commercial use and reproduction with attribution. Online applications must link metadata; pass terms on with redistributed data. Layer credit: Öffentlicher Verkehr © Amt für öffentlichen Verkehr und Verkehrskoordination des Kantons Bern.
cantons.nextAction: Build an explicit operator/line crosswalk and test directed stop patterns across the whole canton, not only BERNMOBIL/RBS.

cantons.name: Luzern
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Verkehrsverbund Luzern (VVL); rawi / Geoportal Luzern
cantons.evidence: Cantonal bus layer advertises 114 features and returns GeoJSON. Fields include BUL_ROUTE, FP_JAHR, LINIENNR, KURSBUCHNR and a local TU enumeration. Rail, boat and stop products are also documented. Coverage includes bus lines with at least one section inside the canton.
cantons.vintage: Bus layer: 26 May 2026; annual timetable update. Stop layers have different dates.
cantons.reuse: Bus product is Open-By; retain the required rawi Kanton Luzern copyright and metadata. A public access class alone is not the licence.
cantons.nextAction: Download full lines, decode TU enums rather than treating them as GTFS IDs, and measure regional as well as vbl patterns.

cantons.name: Uri
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Uri public transport planning; geo.ur.ch
cantons.evidence: WFS capabilities expose a bus-stop inventory and cableway/ski-lift axes and stations. No bus-route vector layer was verified in the advertised service. Cableway axes need passenger/ski/freight filtering.
cantons.vintage: No bus-line vintage established; date each ancillary layer separately.
cantons.reuse: Layer-specific reuse terms remain to be established before importing the ancillary geometry.
cantons.nextAction: Scope Auto AG Uri, PostAuto and Andermatt services; obtain bus alignments or run a measured road-matching pilot.

cantons.name: Schwyz
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Schwyz public transport planning; cantonal geodata portal
cantons.evidence: Published WMS catalogue checked. National rail/topographic and other transport-adjacent layers are present; no current bus-line vector export was established. Existing Rigi coverage does not establish cantonal bus coverage.
cantons.vintage: No local bus-line source vintage established.
cantons.reuse: No bus dataset-specific reuse permission established.
cantons.nextAction: Review Auto AG Schwyz, Freienbach and scoped PostAuto/SOB patterns, including links into Zug, Uri and Zürich.

cantons.name: Obwalden
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Obwalden public transport planning; GIS Daten AG
cantons.evidence: Official OW WMS capabilities checked; no public transport line layer identified. Regional Luzern sources may contain through-lines but are not canton-complete evidence. Engelberg must be reviewed as an OW exclave.
cantons.vintage: No cantonal bus-line vintage established.
cantons.reuse: No local line dataset licence established.
cantons.nextAction: Inventory PostAuto, Zentralbahn and Engelberg local services, then separate mountain geometry and winter/summer calendars.

cantons.name: Nidwalden
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Nidwalden public transport planning; GIS Daten AG
cantons.evidence: WMS advertises ch.nw.oeffentlicher-verkehr (NW075), a combined public transport map, and NW076 cableways. Rendering capability confirms a map exists; no reusable vector line download was acquired.
cantons.vintage: Layer data vintage unresolved.
cantons.reuse: WMS visibility does not establish vector redistribution rights.
cantons.nextAction: Locate the underlying NW075 line export, distinguish tariff/stop/quality polygons, and validate PostAuto and lake connections.

cantons.name: Glarus
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Glarus public transport planning; cantonal geoinformation
cantons.evidence: Public WFS capabilities checked; no public transport route layer identified among the advertised layers. Roads and other line themes must not be mistaken for service paths.
cantons.vintage: No local bus-line vintage established.
cantons.reuse: General cantonal open-geodata policy is a lead; a particular transport dataset and its terms still need identification.
cantons.nextAction: Use national timetable and rail baseline; investigate Sernftal/PostAuto bus alignments and separately validate mountain/lake services.

cantons.name: Zug
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Zug public transport planning; GIS Kanton Zug
cantons.evidence: Official Buslinien ZIP downloaded: Shapefile, GeoPackage, INTERLIS and DXF. GeoPackage has 175 LineString records in EPSG:2056 with id, t_id and liniennummer. WFS exposes line-specific layers. Future vehicle-length/planning layers are separate products.
cantons.vintage: Archive Last-Modified 18 September 2025; 2026 alignment validity is not proven by the current portal.
cantons.reuse: Free commercial/noncommercial use with mandatory credit: Quelle: GIS Kanton Zug.
cantons.nextAction: Compare WFS and archive versions, normalise line labels and test operator/direction/branch joins against current ZVB services.

cantons.name: Fribourg / Freiburg
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Fribourg mobility planning; cantonal geoportal / SIT
cantons.evidence: ArcGIS Theme_mobilite layer 2 is a queryable polyline source: 128 total features. GeoJSON samples include rail and actual TPF urban buses. NUMERO_LIGNE values such as 20.002 are timetable-field identifiers, not simply display line 2. Other fields include type, enterprise and name.
cantons.vintage: Current geometry vintage not established; service response date is only an access check.
cantons.reuse: Exact matching OGD feature service permits free attributed vector use, sharing and reuse (Source: Etat de Fribourg). All 128 geometries and original attributes independently reconciled; catalogue evidence retained in data/fribourg-sources.
cantons.nextAction: Review remaining road and rail failures, source vintage and physical direction; extend unsupported lake/mountain coverage and seasonal dates. Full bus patterns have inferred OSM fallback; 35 reviewed rail route identities now have exact-operating-point FOT inference with gauge, topology, detour and full-context guards. Two reviewed Kerzers BLS platforms and one independent SBB Däniken curve resolve 51 further dated journeys without changing existing admitted paths. A terminal-only Bern 49/50 approach review adds another 20 journeys per date while retaining the original station-distance limit. The Sunday S50/S51 closure is checked against dated TPF evidence.

cantons.name: Solothurn
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Amt für Verkehr und Tiefbau; Amt für Geoinformation Solothurn
cantons.evidence: ch.so.avt.oev GeoPackage downloaded: 3,951 MultiLineString network segments and 775 stops in EPSG:2056. Network fields only identify mode and tunnel status; there are no line/operator identifiers. Stops include DiDok. The empty linestructure helper table is not missing network coverage.
cantons.vintage: Published 17 December 2025. Metadata explicitly excludes night services.
cantons.reuse: Linked dataset terms permit commercial/noncommercial use; source attribution is recommended.
cantons.nextAction: Use the residual-gap audit to review Arlesheim tram platform E, conflicting Egerkingen 501 approaches and Pieterlen EV4 departure alternatives. It also inventories winter BOGG 507/N51 and summer S23/S26/A01 gaps. The IC81 Interlaken and IR17 Bern platform reviews add 12 seasonal journeys with prior geometry preserved. September exclusions remain 123 Friday / 124 Sunday; physical direction and year-round coverage remain uncertified.

cantons.name: Basel-Stadt
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Basel-Stadt mobility planning; Geoportal / BVB
cantons.evidence: Official line WFS remains reachable. The separate Basel study contains more advanced BVB/BLT joins and diversion handling; its current audit is authoritative for measured coverage. A successful BS source check is not a complete TNW claim.
cantons.vintage: Use the exact source snapshots and operating dates in the Basel audit.
cantons.reuse: Retain the BS source attribution and the dataset terms already tracked by the Basel pipeline.
cantons.nextAction: Extend from measured BVB/BLT patterns to all regional operators and cross-border branches, maintaining separate baseline and diversion geometry.

cantons.name: Basel-Landschaft
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Basel-Landschaft public transport planning; GeoView / GeoShop
cantons.evidence: TNW/transport Shapefile is advertised in prior official metadata research, but this pass did not acquire the export. Direct metadata request returned 403. The existing Basel audit has stronger evidence for individual BVB/BLT paths, not the whole canton.
cantons.vintage: Advertised export vintage not independently established.
cantons.reuse: Resolve the exact dataset terms and automated acquisition, not just a portal login.
cantons.nextAction: Obtain the advertised export and audit AAGL, PostAuto and BLT regional bus patterns, including through-lines in the Aargau source.

cantons.name: Schaffhausen
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Schaffhausen public transport planning; cantonal GIS / vbsh
cantons.evidence: Public OGD directory checked. Traffic-load data are available but are not transit service geometry. A portal journey planner using search.ch/OSM is not evidence of a reusable official line export. vbsh has multiple feed identities.
cantons.vintage: No bus-line source vintage established.
cantons.reuse: No bus-line dataset licence established.
cantons.nextAction: Inventory both vbsh identities and cross-border routes; obtain official alignments or validate road matching, including German enclaves and termini.

cantons.name: Appenzell Ausserrhoden
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Appenzell Ausserrhoden public transport planning; Geoinformation und Vermessung
cantons.evidence: KTAR WMS capabilities checked; no actual public transport line network identified. The regional geodata shop advertises GeoPackage acquisition with registration, but that does not establish a bus dataset. SG subsidised-line coverage cannot be extended to all AR by assumption.
cantons.vintage: No local bus-line vintage established.
cantons.reuse: Cantonal data-source credit and dataset-specific terms need carrying through any acquired export.
cantons.nextAction: Review AB rail and bus separately, plus Herisau and PostAuto; investigate local export availability before road matching.

cantons.name: Appenzell Innerrhoden
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Appenzell Innerrhoden public transport planning; cantonal Geoportal
cantons.evidence: KTAI WMS and official portal checked. Transport-related matches are rail-noise or contaminated-site layers, not passenger service paths. No bus-line export verified. Flexible PubliCar service areas cannot be rendered as fixed scheduled routes.
cantons.vintage: No bus-line vintage established.
cantons.reuse: No transport dataset-specific licence established.
cantons.nextAction: Separate fixed AB/PostAuto services, flexible bookings and mountain operators; include Oberegg rather than treating the canton as contiguous.

cantons.name: St.Gallen
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Amt für öffentlichen Verkehr; AREG / Geoportal St.Gallen
cantons.evidence: Full AL_OEV archive acquired: 226 features in five layers. Complete SG polygon census inventories 343 annual GTFS route records across 38 agencies. Weekday/Sunday full-pattern admission emits 10,652 / 7,325 movement instances; 196 route records contribute and all exclusions are retained. A corroborated 7.37 m source-edge repair restores line 321; a documented 210/211 shared corridor with individually approved directed pairs restores line 210. See docs/ST-GALLEN-STUDY.md and data/st-gallen-audit/summary.json. Historical 404 probes remain preserved. A pinned Vorarlberg stop rendering anchor restores line 164 while retaining its original Swiss coordinate in the audit. A documented joint-operation corridor restores line 24 to Vaduz Post with two exact directed platform-pair approvals.
cantons.vintage: 2026 timetable alignment; archive and supplied documentation dated 24 March 2026. No per-feature survey date. Live September documentation date is distinct from pinned geometry vintage.
cantons.reuse: Publisher-specific restricted terms. Supplied 2019 terms and current website terms retain redistribution/own-geoservice permission requirements. Raw/decoded vectors and regional payloads stay local outside public assets. Attribution, date, lack of legal effect and disclaimer documented.
cantons.nextAction: Resolve redistribution permission, remaining geometry/direction exclusions and seasonal/holiday validation. Shared-corridor and source-edge regressions preserve every previously admitted journey and matched path. No generic proximity stitching or operator-wide fallback.

cantons.name: Graubünden / Grigioni / Grischun
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Amt für Energie und Verkehr; ALG / GeoGR
cantons.evidence: Entire annual pinned GTFS census: 380 routes / 67 agencies. Numerically validated initial FOT rail and attributed OSM bus scope: 6270 Friday and 5088 Sunday complete journeys. All candidates, inactive records and whole-pattern exclusions retained. Catalogue and embedded service inventory still return ORA-24415; official search documentation confirms local transport layers, but no current operational line export with verified reuse was acquired.
cantons.vintage: GTFS 20260902; FOT segment Stand 2021-07-06 / asset updated 2025-01-18; OSM Switzerland 2026-09-02 plus border 2026-09-08. Local bus-line vintage unverified.
cantons.reuse: Timetable platform terms; attributed FOT and swisstopo data; attributed OSM derived bus path database under ODbL. No unverified GR local vectors incorporated.
cantons.nextAction: Resolve local layer export/crosswalk/reuse, Sagliains and missing new rail operating points, rejected border/valley bus patterns and seasonal/mountain geometry. See docs/GRAUBUENDEN-STUDY.md.

cantons.name: Aargau
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Abteilung Verkehr; AGIS Service Center
cantons.evidence: AGIS.avk_oevlinien Shapefile acquired. DBF has 366 records with mode, line number, direction, itinerary, timetable field and GO operator code/name. It includes through-lines outside AG, e.g. AAGL 72. DBF properties and archive structure inspected; shapefile coordinates not yet decoded.
cantons.vintage: Dataset filename and metadata: 23 April 2026. Normal timetable only; temporary diversions explicitly excluded. HTTP Last-Modified in September is not the geometry date.
cantons.reuse: August 2024 terms: generally free use, required credit Daten des Kantons Aargau; API limit 20 requests/minute and WMS 10/minute. Preserve the supplied terms; do not relabel as CC0.
cantons.nextAction: Decode LV95 geometry and crosswalk GO_NR plus line/direction against ordered GTFS stops; audit night branches and handle diversions separately.

cantons.name: Thurgau
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Thurgau public transport planning; cantonal geoinformation
cantons.evidence: Full original WFS GML preserved: 337 bus segments, 17 rail corridors, 337 bus-frequency features, 718 stops and four call-taxi areas. Canton-wide annual GTFS census: 132 routes, 15 agencies, all five districts. Added 77 complete OSM-inferred city patterns for Frauenfeld/Kreuzlingen; added 296 audited regional road patterns (292 complete) across 59 fixed route records; federal rail adds 169 unique complete patterns (476 Friday/490 Sunday journeys), including the explicit Interlaken IC81 platform-group join. Detailed SBB Konstanz border links add 61 unique full patterns (212 Friday/207 Sunday journeys). Friday/Sunday feeds now admit 4360/2724 journeys, with every prior admitted path preserved. The separately audited OSM Bregenz rail corridor admits all 10 Friday/14 Sunday Bregenz S7 journeys through St. Margrethen platforms 2/3, including one exact passenger-tagged connector. All 919 Friday/895 Sunday rail journeys now have geometry. Official swissTLMRegio shipping linework adds 26 complete boat journeys per date across four route identities, with six full patterns and eleven docks reviewed against original Bodensee/Untersee shorelines. A separately pinned Wittenbach road/roundabout inference resolves the four original zero-distance matcher failures, adding 37 Friday journeys. All 3361 Friday/1754 Sunday fixed bus journeys now have full geometry. See docs/THURGAU-STUDY.md and data/thurgau-audit. The separately pinned OSM Romanshorn–Friedrichshafen ferry way adds 32 Friday/28 Sunday journeys across both SBS/BSB identities and both directions; all dated line 3810 journeys now have full geometry. The first two boat stages admit 58/54 journeys; previous admitted paths are unchanged. Eight exact OSM lake/Rhine ways and a pinned river polygon add 22 Friday/21 Sunday journeys while retaining successful official segments. All dated Schaffhausen–Büsingen–Diessenhofen journeys now have geometry in both directions. Total boat admission is 80/75 journeys across all seven boat route identities.
cantons.vintage: Geometry effective date remains unknown. WFS acquired 2026-09-08; cantonal catalogue modified 2026-07-31; creation 2000-01-01 is not a geometry vintage. GTFS feed 20260902; boundaries 2026-01. Federal rail source Stand 2021-07-06 and asset update 2025-01-18; reused 2026-09-08, not certified 2026 service geometry. SBB graphical-line catalogue modified 2026-07-29, data processed 2026-09-02; no individual feature survey date established. Border OSM query is pinned to 2026-09-02T00:00:00Z, acquired 2026-09-08. Shipping sources acquired 2026-09-08; swissTLMRegio collection updated 2026-06-25 with temporal extent through 2025-12-02, individual feature survey date unknown. FOEN shoreline reference is 2007. Wittenbach uses historical OSM state 2026-09-02; selected road version 9 dated 2026-08-02 and roundabout version 14 dated 2024-01-29, acquired 2026-09-08. Ferry OSM way 26255860 version 25 was edited 2025-11-05; historical state 2026-09-02, acquired 2026-09-08. Selected node edit dates retained; no verified survey or shipping-lane date. Additional shipping ways use historical OSM state 2026-09-02, acquired 2026-09-08; selected ways edited 2025-04-16–2025-12-21. Rhine water relation 1679977 v3 edited 2026-01-19 retains Landsat source and its island; no contemporary water-level or navigability evidence.
cantons.reuse: Cantonal geometry: CC BY 4.0, as explicitly declared in the preserved data.tg.ch catalogue. City and regional road supplements: OpenStreetMap-derived databases under ODbL 1.0, distributed separately with attribution. GTFS and swisstopo retain separate terms. Federal rail retains FOT source attribution and opendata.swiss terms_by; proprietary catalogue label preserved. SBB Infrastructure / data.sbb.ch border curves retain terms_by attribution, with original metadata and selected responses distributed beside the feed. The separate OSM-derived Bregenz rail path database is ODbL 1.0 with OpenStreetMap attribution. Shipping: © swisstopo; shoreline: © FOEN, swisstopo. Free-geodata terms and the literal proprietary STAC catalogue label are preserved beside the feed. The separately distributed Wittenbach turnaround inference is ODbL 1.0, credited to OpenStreetMap contributors. The separate Romanshorn ferry geometry database is ODbL 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors; original shoreline validation retains © FOEN, swisstopo. The separate combined official/OSM shipping database retains ODbL 1.0 and OpenStreetMap attribution, with original swisstopo/FOEN terms and credit on retained official segments and lake shoreline.
cantons.nextAction: Resolve 12 boat journeys per date: two Kreuzlingen–Mainau–Meersburg, one Romanshorn–Immenstaad loop and nine longer URh lake/Seerhein journeys. Whole patterns remain excluded for unresolved geometry; Schaffhausen–Diessenhofen river geometry is now complete on both dates. Obtain true cantonal geometry vintage and validate seasonal/holiday service and physical direction. All dated fixed bus and rail patterns have full geometry. Wittenbach uses an explicitly inferred 224 m mapped-road turnaround with unchanged platforms and subsequent matcher slices; operator routing remains unverified. NT and type-715 RUB remain demand-responsive exclusions. The ferry uses one explicitly named OSM way with 10 m attachment and shoreline limits; operator identity is checked, operational routing remains inferred. Lake/Rhine replacements preserve successful official segments and use strict pair-specific dock/water limits; the Meersburg source operator-tag conflict and 100 m dock discrepancy zone are explicit in the audit.

cantons.name: Ticino
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Sezione della mobilità / Ufficio dei trasporti pubblici; Centro di competenza geoinformazione
cantons.evidence: WFS (314 feature types), WMS, download catalogue, legal catalogue and reuse terms checked 2026-09-08. Public transport is TI-12, not TI-11 (road axes). No TI-12 line vector distribution acquired. All 209 Ticino-calling national GTFS routes inventoried; initial full-journey rail/OSM bus scope integrated.
cantons.vintage: No acquired bus-line dataset vintage established.
cantons.reuse: Official access-A cantonal data permit modification, redistribution and commercial use with Fonte: Amministrazione cantonale - Canton Ticino. WFS requests formal contact; TI-12 distribution and vintage remain unresolved. Initial bus paths attributed under ODbL; FOT and national timetable terms retained separately.
cantons.nextAction: Obtain TI-12 distribution and dated cross-border line identifiers; resolve excluded rail endpoints, bus timing/geometry outliers, mountain and lake geometry; validate additional seasonal dates.

cantons.name: Vaud
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Direction générale de la mobilité et des routes; Direction du cadastre et de la géoinformation / viageo
cantons.evidence: Transports publics (complet) documents road, rail, lake lines and commercial stops. Lines continuing into neighbouring cantons are digitised in full. XML metadata links WMS road/rail/lake layers. The export is supplied through an order workflow; no vector export acquired.
cantons.vintage: Data 6 March 2026; metadata 5 June 2026; annual update in first quarter.
cantons.reuse: Catalogue advertises CHF 1/km², minimum CHF 1/maximum CHF 3,000 plus CHF 25 per order, with conditional exemptions. Licence/order conditions require resolution for the intended delivery; no exemption assumed.
cantons.nextAction: Resolve distribution cost and reuse terms, then audit the whole canton. Existing Lausanne/tl work is not evidence for Nyon, TRAVYS, Riviera or Chablais bus coverage.

cantons.name: Valais / Wallis
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Service de la mobilité; Centre de compétence géomatique
networks: Regional/cross-border tickets (no single canton-wide tariff union in SBB list)
cantons.evidence: Official geodata inventory row 376 identifies Transport en commun / Öffentlicher Verkehr, owner SDM. Its publication/download channel cells are blank. This establishes a data lead, not a current open line export. Geoservices portal is reachable.
cantons.vintage: Inventory generated 26 August 2026; transport dataset row dated 5 July 2018.
cantons.reuse: No public-vector distribution channel or dataset licence established.
cantons.nextAction: Locate current SDM data and review Rhône valley plus each side valley, separating RegionAlps, TMR, MGB, TPC and local bus identities.

cantons.name: Neuchâtel
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Canton Neuchâtel transport planning; SITN
cantons.evidence: Public SITN WMS capabilities and services documentation checked. No transport line export verified in that service. Published stop metadata and transport digitisation documentation are leads, not an acquired bus graph. transN spans multiple rail, bus and funicular identities.
cantons.vintage: No acquired line-layer vintage established.
cantons.reuse: No bus-line dataset-specific terms established.
cantons.nextAction: Resolve line-layer distribution with SITN metadata, then audit all transN feed identities and through operators rather than a single brand match.

cantons.name: Jura
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Service du développement territorial / transports; SIT Jura
cantons.evidence: WMS advertises ju.sdt_09_07_lignes_de_bus, night-bus and railway layers. WFS does not advertise those transport layers. Bus-layer XML metadata returned, but its distribution links are rendered images; the PDF and geodata-inventory endpoints returned 500.
cantons.vintage: Bus-line geometry vintage unresolved.
cantons.reuse: WMS rendering and image download do not grant raw-vector redistribution rights.
cantons.nextAction: Locate vector distribution and terms, map MOBIJU branding to actual feed routes, and audit night lines, French termini and current administrative boundaries.

cantons.name: Genève
cantons.authorityAndPublisher: Office cantonal des transports; TPG / SITG
cantons.evidence: TPG_LIGNES metadata and ArcGIS GeoJSON samples are accessible. Fields include LIGNE, NOM_LIGNE, DIRECTION, VEHICULE and TYPE_SERVICE. OBJECTID is explicitly not a permanent identifier. Existing TPG integration is a baseline; lake and Léman Express are separate operator/geometry scopes.
cantons.vintage: Metadata advertises twice-yearly updating and publication 12 June 2025; metadata refresh on 8 September 2026 is not a new geometry vintage.
cantons.reuse: SITG marks access as free but dataset use restrictions are unfilled. Preserve existing SITG/TPG credits and resolve applicable reuse terms for any new redistribution.
cantons.nextAction: Refresh the pinned line data and revalidate directed branches and French termini; include boats and railway records through explicit route scoping.
